DECLARE @DimTable varchar(50)  = 'GLEntryFact'
DECLARE @DimPrimaryKey varchar(50) = 'GLEntryNumber'

DECLARE @DynSQL varchar(MAX) = ''

SET @DynSQL =
'UPDATE rpt.' + @DimTable + ' 
SET IsCurrent = 0 WHERE CAST(' + @DimPrimaryKey + ' as VARCHAR(255)) + SourceEntityCol IN 

(SELECT CAST(s.' + @DimPrimaryKey + ' as VARCHAR(255)) + s.SourceEntityCol
FROM stg.' + @DimTable + ' s
LEFT JOIN rpt.' + @DimTable + ' r ON r.ETLHashKey = s.ETLHashKey AND r.SourceEntityCol = s.SourceEntityCol
WHERE r.' + @DimPrimaryKey  + ' IS NULL)'

EXEC (@DynSQL)

DECLARE @DimTable varchar(50)  = 'GLEntryFact'
DECLARE @DimPrimaryKey varchar(50) = 'GLEntryNumber'

DECLARE @DynSQL varchar(MAX) = ''

SET @DynSQL = 

'UPDATE rpt.' + @DimTable + ' SET
IsCurrent = 0 WHERE CAST(' + @DimPrimaryKey + ' as VARCHAR(255)) + SourceEntityCol IN (
SELECT CAST(r.' + @DimPrimaryKey + ' as VARCHAR(255)) + r.SourceEntityCol
  FROM stg.' + @DimTable +' s
  RIGHT JOIN rpt.' + @DimTable + ' r ON r.ETLHashKey = s.ETLHashKey AND r.SourceEntityCol = s.SourceEntityCol
  WHERE CAST(s.' + @DimPrimaryKey + ' as VARCHAR(255)) + s.SourceEntityCol IS NULL AND r.IsCurrent = 1
)'

EXEC (@DynSQL)
